units.source_text: 他裹着黑色制服的脊背，在我的眼下激烈地起伏。

en.t: His back, wrapped in a black uniform, rose and fell violently below my eyes.

units.source_text: 看上去他的匍匐的姿势不像是个人，一瞬间倒像是一个无意义的黑色的大污点，像是雨后路面上的一汪混浊的积水。

en.t: The way he was crawling did not look human; for an instant he seemed instead like a meaningless large black stain, like a puddle of muddy water on the road after rain.
